=== CALLEE SUMMARY ===
The method aims to arrange blocks within a container according to a given constraint. It operates on a BlockContainer, a Graphics2D object, and a RectangleConstraint. The method calculates dimensions for top, bottom, left, right, and center blocks, arranging and setting their bounds accordingly. It returns a Size2D object representing the total width and height of the arrangement.

At line <L>, it calls getWidth(). getWidth()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to retrieve the width value of a rectangle constraint. It achieves this by accessing and returning the stored width attribute from the rectangle constraint object.  
At line <L>, it calls getHeight(). getHeight()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to retrieve the height value of a rectangle constraint. It achieves this by accessing and returning the stored height attribute from the rectangle constraint object.  
At line <L>, it calls arrange(). arrange()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to organize or layout graphical elements within a block. It achieves this by calculating positions and dimensions to fit the elements according to specified layout rules or constraints.  
At line <L>, it calls setBounds(). setBounds()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to define the position and size of a block within a chart. It achieves this by setting the block's boundaries using specified coordinates and dimensions.
